author: MGTKlaus
quote: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is, in my opinion, the greatest Zelda game ever made. Everything about it feels special, from the sense of adventure and memorable dungeons to the amazing soundtrack and unforgettable story. Watching Link's journey from a child to the Hero of Time remains one of gaming's most iconic experiences.Even after all these years, the game still captures a sense of wonder that few games can match. It's a timeless classic that helped define the Zelda series and remains the standard I compare every other Zelda game to.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: MGTKlaus
quote:
GTA VI is gorgeous, but that's not enough. The world is beautiful, packed with insane detail, and technically impressive, but the story feels mediocre and the pacing is painfully slow. It takes far too long to get interesting, and the main relationship never felt compelling enough to carry the narrative.Rockstar also made several decisions that are hard to defend: no physical edition, a disappointing Collector's Edition, two delays, no 60 FPS at launch, and a $100 digital price tag. For a game that took this long to release, I expected a lot **** visuals are phenomenal, but everything around them left me feeling underwhelmed

World 10/10 
Story 2/10 
Graphics 6/10
Business over all 0/10

author: MGTKlaus
quote: What a journey! This game, from the beginning, has been great and has gotten better with each update. Not only is the story interesting, but the gameplay and the world are, too. The vision and the land are just mesmerizing. From the very beginning, when this was announced, I was skeptical about how ambitious this game was, and then when it came out and I started playing, I bought it without hesitation, and it's been fantastic. Almost 400 hours later, I'm still enjoying it.
